entries.summary: Confused by Floyd's Cycle Detection Algorithm? In this short, you'll learn the famous Tortoise & Hare technique: 🐢 A slow pointer moves one step at a time 🐇 A fast pointer moves two steps at a time 🔄 If a cycle exists, the fast pointer will eventually meet the slow pointer 🚫 If the fast pointer reaches the end, there's no cycle ✅ Detect a cycle without using extra memory ⚡ Time Complexity: O(n) 💾 Space Complexity: O(1) This is a must-know algorithm for coding interviews and is used in problems like Linked List Cycle (LeetCode 141) and Find the Duplicate Number (LeetCode 287).
